text_block_list.text:
The "URA Awards"—every year, the URA 
honors Umamusume who delivered outstanding 
performances across various categories.

"The award winners are decided by a press 
vote, and if there are multiple 
candidates, the one with the most votes 
wins. The announcement is held every 
January, and as for this year—"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"The Best Classic Queen Umamusume for this 
year is... Cesario!"

"Cesario's great achievement of winning 
the American Oaks is certainly understood 
and worthy of praise. However—"

I want to give her something, too, to 
celebrate everything she's achieved so 
far. —Before I knew it, my hands were 
already moving.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Man, it's rock hard this year too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, what's with that paper?

...I got caught up in the moment and made 
it, but when the time came to hand it 
over, I hesitated. However—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Come on, show me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"To Daring Heart: In recognition and honor 
of your outstanding achievements 
throughout the year."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"‘On the Tiara route and in the NHK Mile 
Cup, your showdowns against your peers 
brought immense excitement to the 
Umamusume world.’"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"For your reference, a summary of your 
achievements is listed below"... Wow! 
Everything I've done is laid out right 
here...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
From the changes since the Make Debut to 
how the Summer Training Camp went... Hehe. 
...You took the trouble to put all this 
together for me, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Via a slide presentation? ...Hehe, that's 
just so like you!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"But why now? Senior year has only just 
begun."
choice_data_list:
(It's frustrating... but I can't say 
that...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Well, whatever works!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I know how amazing I am. And you... 
acknowledge it too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: That's plenty! Thanks!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to do my best this year too, so 
that you can present me with an award 
again!
choice_data_list:
My goal for this year... is a showdown 
with my rival.

My goal for this year... is a showdown 
with my rival, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'll keep aiming straight for it. 
First up is the Hanshin Umamusume 
Stakes... but—

text_block_list.name: Academy Maintenance Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Craft! Up early today too, huh! 
Though... haven't you been pushing 
yourself a bit too hard lately?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Now's the time to push through! 
Thanks for your hard work right from the 
New Year, mister!

Toward the end of the Classic year, Rhein 
Kraft's race results—including those on 
school grounds—started slumping, and she 
seemed totally out of sorts.
choice_data_list:
(I've been wondering what was causing it, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't look like anything's wrong. Her 
demeanor seems normal, too...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha, I'm okay~! It's not an injury or 
anything at all!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's not a laughing matter, though. 
But really, I'm completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"By the time the Hanshin Umamusume Stakes 
comes around with Heart-san in it, I'll 
make a grand comeback!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A battle over the mile against the Senior 
Class Tiara Umamusume...! I want to win 
too, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Looks like I was worrying over 
nothing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That fighting spirit is what makes you 
Rhein Kraft! My rival!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...I've been wanting to ask you for a 
while. Heart-san, why did you—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
“Do you really see me as that much of a 
rival?”

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I mean, we do run together a lot, sure, 
but Cesario-san and Messiah-san are there 
too... So, I just wonder... why me...?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I'm totally nothing like the Queen you 
dream of, right, Heart-san?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No. You are the Queen.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To be completely honest, I've always 
admired you! Especially back during the 
Junior Class, I thought—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"There is a complete strictly superior 
version of me out there." Surpassing you 
was my immediate goal.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"And those days spent chasing after you... 
were incredibly, incredibly passionate. 
You made the clash of hearts I'd always 
dreamed of come true—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because you reign supreme in my heart. You 
are—my Queen.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Heart-san...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So, Craft. Win brilliantly in the next 
race, and—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"This time, it's my turn to reign supreme 
in your heart!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. No way, no way! The winner's 
gonna be me, me, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Was that really okay? Cutting training 
short like that.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I was pretty much done 
anyway!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, thank you so much for 
letting me join you for Hatsumode!
choice_data_list: No, thank you for keeping me company.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I wish Cesario and Messiah-san could have 
come too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Messiah's visiting home, and Cesario is 
helping out at the youth club, right?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Cesario spends almost all her days 
off over there~

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh. Then... that's a bit lonely, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, right! I was thinking of 
organizing a picnic with everyone soon!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Remember what we did during last year's 
summer training camp? This is the winter 
version of that! It's still a secret from 
Cesario and Messiah, though!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that sounds fun...! Leave picking the 
sunny spot to me!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, another picnic with all four of 
us...! Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...I hope we can all run together again 
someday."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No, we're going to run! Why don't we ask 
for that today as well?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Wow... It's so lively! There are so many 
stalls... and everything looks delicious♪"
choice_data_list: Ah, I brought some snacks, so don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it's not like I was particularly 
hungry, you know? Thank you, though.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Could that cute heart-patterned lunch 
bag be... for your snacks?
choice_data_list:
I wanted to make it so Heart could eat it 
right away

text_block_list.text:
From the survival routine at last year's 
summer camp to the fierce battle at the 
Shuka Sho... her body weight had dropped 
significantly for a time.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Lately, she's started making me bento 
boxes to add to my regular meals.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
They said they'd procure it themselves, 
because they want to calculate their 
calories perfectly...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...! That's amazing, true love right 
there...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, yes. I can definitely feel the 
love!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ah! We can pray over there, right? Let's 
go!

I put my hands together and pray with all 
my heart. That this year, Daring Heart 
will—
choice_data_list:
(May we forge ahead safe and sound in body 
and mind)

(May they enjoy competing against their 
rivals.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Here you go, amazake!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You looked so serious. Craft and I went 
ahead and got it for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's full of nutrients and will warm you 
up! From here on out, not just for me—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I need you to stay healthy too, otherwise 
I'd be in trouble!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, hehehe...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, but... You just looked so grim!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's like your whole body is tensed up... 
Hehe, I don't know what kind of wish you 
made, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I suppose... it's my turn to let you rest 
this year?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I was talking with Craft, you see. How 
would you like to do a joint training 
session after this?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If you run with me, don't you think it'd 
sharpen your competitive instincts even 
more, Craft?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, even though we're rivals... is it 
really okay for you to help me out?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because you're my rival, duh! I want to 
race you at your best!
choice_data_list:
Alright, shall we head back to the 
academy?
Alright, let's head back to the academy

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm counting on you for a perfect 
tandem training routine!
